content: आध्मानम् [आ-ध्मा-ल्युट्] .²1 Blowing inflation; (<ab>fig.</ab>) growth, increase; अयं विन्ध्यो येनाहृतविहृतिराध्मानमजहात् <ls>Mv. 7. 14</ls>. .²2 Boasting, vaunting. .²3 A bellows. .²4 Intumescence, swelling of the belly, body <ab>&c.</ab>, dropsy. .{@-नी@} .²1 A kind of fragrant substance. .²2 A blow-pipe.
